items.title: Narva officials seek humanitarian corridor across Russian border
items.summary: Anton Nikolayev, chairman of the ruling faction in Narva's city council, reportedly said municipal authorities would ask Estonia's government to establish a humanitarian corridor with Russia.

items.title: Russia reports progress on Crimean Bridge restoration
items.summary: Russian Deputy Prime Minister Marat Khusnullin said restoration work on the bridge linking Russia to occupied Crimea was progressing and that all project documentation had been prepared.
